theme_overview.vibe: High-end 2026 SaaS, industrial command center, premium dark theme ('FarmBuddy' style)
theme_overview.emotional_tone: Command-center focus, reliable, precise, high-tech agricultural
theme_overview.theme_preference: Dark-first (with theme toggle for light mode fallback)

headings.usage_rules: Do not use Inter for headings. Use Outfit for a modern tech feel with tight tracking on H1/H2.

body.usage_rules: Optimal for dense data grids and dashboards. Use for all feed grid numerics, body text, and labels.

visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Use 'backdrop-blur-xl bg-black/60 border border-white/10' for the Right Silo Panel and Top Header. Ensures data doesn't feel flat.
visual_enhancers.borders: 1px delicate inner stroke on elevated surfaces (border-white/5 to border-white/10).
visual_enhancers.shadows: Soft diffuse ambient shadows (shadow-2xl shadow-black/50) for modal elements and dropdowns.
visual_enhancers.textures: Optional subtle noise/grain overlay (opacity-5) on the main app wrapper to kill 'digital flatness'.

layouts.app_shell: CSS Grid or Flex layout. Left Sidebar (fixed 240px, collapses on mobile). Main Content (fluid). Right Silo Panel (320px fixed on desktop, bottom drawer or collapsed on <1280px).
layouts.header: Sticky top, z-50, backdrop-blur glass effect. Contains breadcrumbs, theme toggle, and profile.
layouts.flock_forecast_grid: Bento-style High Density Grid for KPIs. Base: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3. Gap: gap-4. Utilize h-full for stretching.
layouts.feed_program_grid: Full-width complex table. Sticky first column (Day/Date) and sticky table header. Horizontal and vertical scrolling enabled.

components.silo_gauge: Semi-circle gauge chart (via Recharts or SVG). Must be animated on load to fill up to the current total capacity percentage. Colored arcs for Critical (Red), Low (Amber), OK (Green).
components.kpi_tiles: Flat solid background or glass effect, 1px border. Value text should use Outfit text-4xl font-semibold. Subtle icon in top-right with brand-muted background.
components.feed_grid_table: Dense cells. Use rich color-coded status pips (small rounded indicators 8px by 8px or subtle background tints). Today's row gets a distinct highlight (e.g., border-l-2 border-primary bg-primary/5).
components.sliders: Customized Shadcn Slider for 'Catch Day' and 'Target Weight'. Accent color matches primary green.
components.charts: Recharts. Dark theme grids (stroke='#272B36'). Actual data = solid line. Forecast data = dashed line. Use dot={false} or subtle dots on hover. Tooltips must have dark glassmorphism background.

motion.hero_moment: On initial app load, trigger a staggered Framer Motion entrance for the main Feed grid rows or Forecast KPI tiles (y: 20, opacity: 0 -> y: 0, opacity: 1, stagger: 0.05). The Silo gauge MUST animate its stroke-dashoffset from 0 to actual value over 1.5s.
motion.micro_interactions: Buttons get a subtle scale-down on tap (scale: 0.98). Table rows get a very subtle bg-white/5 on hover.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text against status colors meets APCA/WCAG standards. Use darker variants of status colors for text if placed on light backgrounds, or white text on dark status backgrounds.
accessibility.testing_attributes: All interactive elements, buttons, tabs, and form inputs MUST have 'data-testid' attributes (e.g., data-testid='start-batch-btn').

media.icons: Use lucide-react for all UI icons. Keep stroke-width consistent (usually 1.5 or 2).
media.charts_library: Use Recharts for the Silo gauge, Weight Growth Curve, and Daily Feed Usage Forecast.

avatar_placeholder.description: Elderly Australian farmer portrait for the user profile avatar in the header.

phased_implementation_plan.title: Shell & Theme Overhaul
phased_implementation_plan.description: Establish the 2026 dark theme tokens. Build the layout shell: Left Sidebar (240px), Sticky Header, and Right Silo Panel (320px). Implement the hero load-in animation for the shell.

phased_implementation_plan.title: Feed Program Redesign & Silo Panel
phased_implementation_plan.description: Refactor the main feed grid without breaking xlsx math. Add sticky headers/columns, color-coded pips, and quick-nav strip. Build the Silo Gauge (animated) and individual Silo cards in the Right Panel.

phased_implementation_plan.title: Flock Forecast Page (New)
phased_implementation_plan.description: Create the new Flock Forecast view. Build the Parameter Sliders, Bento-style KPI tiles with staggered animations, Recharts Growth/Feed charts, and the Feed Order Planner list.

universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: CRITICAL: Treat all files as .js/.jsx. The project uses standard JavaScript/JSX, not TypeScript (.tsx), despite any initial prompts mentioning App.tsx. Double check the file extensions before writing.
DO NOT break the existing xlsx-driven math logic or the mobile Reader companion app.
NEVER use generic placeholder image URLs (like via.placeholder). Use the provided image_urls for avatars.
Do not center-align the main app layout. Left-align dense data.
Use 2-3x generous spacing for standard sections, but maintain a dense tight bento grid for the Flock Forecast.
Include 'data-testid' attributes on all actionable elements (buttons, inputs, tabs).
Implement glassmorphism using Tailwind 'backdrop-blur-xl bg-black/60'. Never use fully transparent backgrounds behind text.
